responsibility: This header declares the statement-expansion interfaces exported by stmt.cc. It provides APIs for expanding labels and switches, parsing extended-asm input and output constraints, resolving named asm operands, testing overlaps with hard-register sets, and obtaining or forcing LABEL_DECL RTL, making it the public statement/control-flow companion to expr.h during RTL generation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public statement-expansion entry points for this stem, such as label RTL accessors, asm-constraint parsers, and switch expansion hooks. Unlike gcc/stmt.cc, it is only the interface and does not implement control-flow or asm-lowering behavior.
